title: forsteronia schomburgkii
intro: Forsteronia schomburgkii, commonly known as "Guacá" or "Guacá tree", is a plant species native to the tropical regions of South America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and anxiety, and acting as an anticonvulsant and anxiolytic. The therapeutic actions of Forsteronia schomburgkii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as alkaloids and lignans, which have been shown to interact with the nervous system and exhibit sedative and anticonvulsant properties. Furthermore, studies have identified various compounds, including schomburgkine and schomburgkine B, which contribute to the plant's bioactive profile.
